review: the acropolis museum initially feels expensive at 20 euros per adult admission but on leaving we both felt it was justified it was an incredibly wet day here in athens and we needed an indoor venue the museum is incredibly well laid with so much to see there is a free cloakroom to leave bags and wet coats etc also underneath the museum is a vast excavation which can be visited or viewed through the glass floors see photo one tip is to take a pair of headphones with you to use with your phone for the audio tour also freeincluded the museum have selected i imagine with much difficulty and deliberation about 60 items across the floors to tell you about that takes at least 2 hours we spent a good afternoon here and i would have wanted to return as i felt that there was too much to see and take in great views of the parthenon despite the weather and city from the upper floors lots of staff on hand for advice and guidance an excellent attraction well done
